testCase.name: [本地] S21 axe on the screens TC-25 touches, on desktop and phone profiles

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A4 · P2 · 无障碍

多处文字对比度不达 AA（问卷按钮 3.66:1，Previous Notes 标题 2.5:1，dashboard 房号行等）

票：— · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-06/S24a, TC-13/S22, TC-20/S18

思路 / Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S21 「在 TC-25 碰到的界面上跑 axe，桌面和手机 profile」 axe on the screens TC-25 touches, on desktop and phone profiles

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 The same account is signed in on a phone (app) and a computer (web) at the same time. Signing in on one does not sign out the other, and both stay signed in.（UAT TC-25 step 1；UAT TC-25；TFA-94513 AC 9；TFA-94704 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U2 A patient added on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh or re-entry.（UAT TC-25 step 2；UAT TC-25；TFA-94704 AC 5；TFA-94513 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U5 A patient deleted on the computer disappears from the phone in real time.（UAT TC-25 step 5；UAT TC-25；TFA-94513 AC 18；TFA-94704 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual lane profiles desktop, Pixel 7 and iPhone 15

When Run axe on the sign-in form, both lists, both charts and the chart of a patient deleted from the other device; on an open list, focus a card's control and delete that patient from the other context

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations; the sign-in fields have labels; after the remote delete keyboard focus is not lost to the page body (WCAG 2.4.3)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core violation count = 0 (visual-checks.ts); document.activeElement after the remote delete is recorded as evidence for a person

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（blocked）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-25.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94513 in progress；TFA-94704 development backlog

登录页的 Send code 按钮和页脚、病人列表、病历页都有对比度不够的文字；另一台设备删掉病人后，键盘焦点跳到页面最上面。

The sign-in screen's Send code button and footer, the patient lists and the charts have low-contrast text, and after a patient is deleted on another device the keyboard focus jumps to the top of the page.

依据：allure-results/9f57a3da…: 9 pass / 18 fail. axe contrast fails on the sign-in footer and Send-code button, both lists and both charts. Focus after a remote delete falls to the page body (recorded, WCAG 2.4.3). The deleted-elsewhere chart is axe-clean.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-25/S21

axe on the screens TC-25 touches, on desktop and phone profiles

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress); TFA-94704 Production Web App Hosting + PWA (development backlog)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: partly）：account.spec.ts: sign-in form (signed out, code step stubbed), both lists, both charts, a chart whose patient is deleted through the API while open; axe (all), field labels; focus after a remote delete of the focused card recorded for a person. — The focus outcome (WCAG 2.4.3) is recorded for a person per the oracle; two real devices are TC-25's other scenarios.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 9 judged check(s) passed, 18 failed. Sign-in email and code fields are labelled; the deleted-elsewhere chart shows 'Patient not found.' with Back to rounds (axe clean). Focus after deleting the focused patient on the other device falls to the page body (recorded for a person, WCAG 2.4.3).

产品问题：axe violations on the sign-in screen (footer and Send-code contrast), both lists and both charts (oracle: violation count = 0).

只记录的格子（recorded）：After the remote deletes no alert or banner is shown on the list (recorded 'alerts shown on the list after the remote deletes: []' on all three profiles). A red 'Chart access couldn’t be recorded. Check your connection and reload.' banner was seen once, in OAT-03/S22 desktop nh-scan-error (pre-review run, nothing deleted), while the shared local backend was under other jobs' load: not tied to a delete, unconfirmed (convex/access.ts logChartAccess returns null without an error for a missing row). vision-review (for a person): the deleted-elsewhere chart says only 'Patient not found.'

证据：附了 10 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/TC-25_S21 — 目录（51 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key) and make-session.ts refuses dev; the 'deleted elsewhere' screen also needs a second context.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
